title: Chapter 302 Today Is Different From The Past
content:
Chapter 302 Today Is Different From The Past

When he heard Xiao Jing's eager questioning, Lord He frowned and stared at the ancient battlefield, his eyes as if they could penetrate everything.

After a long time, Lord He slowly spoke: "The huge changes in the ancient battlefield should be caused by humans."

Artificial? !

I have to say that this Lord He does have two tricks.

The changes in the ancient battlefield did not escape his eyes at this moment.

Of course, the most important thing is that Lu Daosheng did not cover up at all, just being open and upright.

So what can you do if you know? Will you hit me?

However, after hearing this, Xiao Jing was in a murderous intent, "Fuck, who did it!"

"If I catch it, I will,"

Before he could finish his words, Xiao Jing's mouth was suddenly blocked.

Lord He said in a deep voice: "Be calm, what kind of person do you think will be someone who can do such a defiant thing? Are you not afraid of enduring great cause and effect when saying such words?"

Hearing this, Xiao Jing quickly reacted, and then he was covered in cold sweat.

Yes, it is definitely an easy thing for people who can do this to kill themselves.

It’s a pity that it’s still a little too late to react now.

Buzz —

In the dark, an indescribable force suddenly emerged from the surrounding space, and then wrapped around Xiao Jing's whole body.

Seeing this scene, Xiao Jing was shocked.

"Sir He, save me!"

As soon as he finished speaking, Xiao Jing's face suddenly turned pale and he lost consciousness directly.

Looking at Xiao Jing who was lying on the ground and foaming at the mouth, Lord He on the side did not do anything, but his expression was extremely solemn.

"Just punish, but not killing."

"The world is really vast."

And at this time, movement came from the void in the distance.

laugh!

The space suddenly cracked without warning, revealing the chaotic void turbulence inside. Even if a strong man from the Immortal Saint Realm forced himself into, he would probably be stolen by the violent void turbulence. No left.

But the next moment, several powerful people stepped out of the crack in the space.

There is no doubt that they are all powerful people in the Immortal Emperor Realm, and they are also the tops of the pyramids in the Immortal Emperor Realm.

The roar sounded from the mouth of the head.

"What the hell is going on?!"

Xiao Mo, the leader of the Xiao clan, had almost lost his mind at this moment.

When he saw the changes in the ancient battlefield, he only felt that the sky had collapsed.

If Xiao Luo and Lu Xue both fell in the ancient battlefield, then there is no doubt that everything is over.

Seeing that Xiao Mo, the leader of the Xiao clan, was so dissatisfied, Lord He was obviously a little dissatisfied.

In this way, how can you take great responsibility?

"Captain Xiao, calm down!"

Lord He shouted coldly, then glanced at everyone present.

These are the top group of people in the Xiao clan today, all of which are at the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm. It can be imagined that the Xiao clan is extremely important to this incident.

This made Lord He confused.

But suddenly, he remembered again that it was the woman who entered the ancient battlefield with their Xiao tribe.

It's definitely her!

Otherwise, the Xiao clan would not have reacted so much now.

After Lord He's cold shout, Xiao Mo calmed down his heart a little, but in a blink of an eye, he noticed the great elder lying on the ground twitching all over his body.

"Huh? Great Elder!"

"Who can do this?"

He couldn't believe that someone dared to attack their elder Xiao clan here.

Could it be?

Xiao Mo looked at Lord He in front of him, and asked with his eyes.

"Mr. He?"

Lord He said indifferently: "It's not me, it's him who didn't control his mouth and offended someone who can't afford to offend him."

An existence that can't be offended?

Xiao Mo felt even more confused.

Nowadays, the existence that they can't afford to offend can almost be counted with one hand.

But they had no reason to attack Xiao Jing.

After a moment of silence, Xiao Mo shook his head.

Now it is not a matter of tangling Xiao Jing, but an ancient battlefield.

There must be no accidents in the ancient battlefield.

"Mr. He, you should know that little girl. She must not die inside, otherwise, my Xiao clan will be in trouble!"

Xiao Mo said in a hurry.

Upon hearing this, Lord He nodded slightly.

He also knew the importance of that little girl.

That is definitely not something in the pool.

but,,

Lord He glanced at Xiao Mo and said slowly, "It is useless to be anxious like this. You cannot do anything to interfere in the ancient battlefield."

"That little girl has great luck, and I think it's probably okay."

"The most urgent task now is to deal with things outside the ancient battlefield."

Hearing Lord He's words, Xiao Mo was stunned and his expression became solemn.

I have to say that what Mr. He said is very reasonable.

It’s not that he is stupid, but the impact Lu Daosheng brought to their Xiao clan was too strong, and that’s an existence that even the ancestors feared.

At this moment, the ancient battlefield is still expanding.

The violent internal aura seemed to rush out of the ancient battlefield and vent its vent within the fairyland.

The ancient battlefield was undoubtedly exposed to the vision of the people in the Immortal Realm. Now, their idea of monopolizing the ancient battlefield was ruined.

It may not take long before the four ancient tribes will become the target of public criticism.

Tiandi Academy, inside the inner courtyard hall.

"What do you think about the ancient battlefield?"

An Lingyun, the president of Tiandi Academy, appeared rarely in the hall and held an emergency meeting.

Faced with the dean's question, Li Changqing, the leader of Huoyun Peak, stood up first.

"Our academy cannot stand by and watch the treasure land of resources such as the ancient battlefield."

As he said that, Li Changqing bowed directly to An Lingyun and said, "Dean, I would like to take the disciples of the academy to go there in person."

Hearing this, An Lingyun did not speak, but continued to look at the other mentors.

At this moment, Xiao Yin was not there, and all the tutors in the inner courtyard gathered together.

"Where are you?"

Tan Songci stood up and smiled and said, "Dean, I agree with Lao Li."

As Tan Songci made his statement, the other mentors nodded one after another.

"I agree, too."

"I agree, too."

Of course, they would not know about the ancient battlefield.

Similarly, they also hope that their disciples can get into the training.

The benefits of harvesting are bound to be unimaginable.

Seeing that everyone agreed, An Lingyun frowned all the time.

Seeing this, Tan Songci said in confusion: "Dean, do you have any doubts?"

Everyone also looked at An Lingyun.

They also smelled something wrong.

Logically speaking, when the ancient battlefield was born, the dean should have directly ordered them to go there. Why are they still in a hurry to discuss this time?

At this time, An Lingyun's slightly heavier voice sounded.

"The ancient battlefield is now different from the past. At this moment, the ancient battlefield is in chaos and the danger level has greatly increased. I am afraid that students in our college will encounter unexpected problems after entering."
